note: The status-check contexts the `main` ruleset requires, and the directory sweeps a required job performs through a script rather than through a jest argument a workflow can be read for. This file exists because requiredness lives in GitHub repository settings, which no file in the repository can derive. It is therefore a MIRROR, and a mirror can go stale: `scripts/quality/check-named-suite-requiredness.mjs` narrows that risk by refusing any context here that names no job in `.github/workflows`, and by refusing any indirect sweep whose `provenBy` script does not actually pass `directory` to jest. Neither check can see a context ADDED to the ruleset and not written here, so update this file in the same pull request that changes the ruleset.

indirectSweeps.reason: The floor runs `npm run coverage:behavior-gate`, whose body is `node scripts/ci/check-behavior-coverage.mjs`; the jest argument is inside that script, so no reader of the workflow YAML can see the sweep.
